title: IPC capability
description: A named authority a client may be granted at handshake. The set is CLOSED: an unknown capability name is never silently elevated, and `admin.*` is obtainable only on the administrative socket — never by claiming an administrative `client.kind` on the data socket (ADR-0037). `admin.status` (1.1.0, A 2026-09-28) is the read-only administrative authority: status may be read without holding a mutation capability. `admin.trust` (1.2.0, IPC 2.1, A 2026-10-03) reads and changes the profile's peer trust policy (ADR-0032); a hello names it only once the client has learnt the daemon selects minor 1 or later, and a hello naming it at minor 0 is closed `ProtocolViolation` (LOCAL-IPC.md §Version negotiation).
